primary_comparison: For each fixed base and wording: frozen old P(conflict) on negative suffix minus matched-token neutral suffix. Report all six paired values separately for D and P, signed differences and means as descriptive only.
secondary_comparison: Each negative or neutral suffix minus the saved positive core; three-class probabilities, frozen class, and exact prompt length. No new response behavior is measured.
interpretation: Disagreement between two equal-token additions is evidence against token count alone being a complete explanation for that specific contrast; agreement does not prove length causes the result. Content, token identities, semantics and position differ; no natural-task or mechanism claim.
exposure: Same informed assistant; six val bases used in probe calibration/selection and old results already seen; no independent semantic gold or prospective confirmation.
